title: Emitter counter update in phase one
statement: For any gate kind, natural numbers $z,a,b,j$, and Boolean list $r$, processing $j$ consecutive true bits from phase $u(k,1)$ leaves the output unchanged and increases the second argument counter from $b$ to $b+j$: the resulting run is the run from phase $u(k,1)$ with counters $(z,a,b+j)$ on input $r$.
